about.title: Dorris Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription:
Dorris is a town of about 860 people, small enough that when a family loses someone, the whole town tends to feel it. In the most recent finalized year, public records show one injury collision here and no traffic deaths, which is the outcome everyone hopes for. Yet Route 97 carries steady through-traffic past 1st Street, N Main Street and 4th Street, and reported crashes in Dorris have clustered on Fridays between midnight and 2 a.m. A single bad night can change everything.

California law gives a spouse, domestic partner, or children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs next in line. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a public agency is involved. Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to the income your loved one would have provided and the companionship and guidance now missing. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Siskiyou County families, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Dorris Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out quickly whether you are eligible to bring the claim.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency may share fault. Connecting early keeps those deadlines from slipping.

items.title: Every category of loss counted
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Attorneys in our network document all of it, and charge no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: There were no traffic deaths in Dorris last year. Do wrongful death claims still happen here?
items.answer: Yes. Public records show zero traffic fatalities in Dorris in the most recent finalized year, but wrongful death claims arise from many situations beyond crashes, including medical errors, workplace and ranch accidents, and defective products. Siskiyou County families also lose loved ones on highways outside town limits, and Route 97 traffic passing through Dorris does not stop at the city line.

items.question: The driver who caused the crash is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution, and the two-year filing deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court. Many families move forward with the civil claim while the criminal case is still pending. An attorney can explain how evidence from one may be useful in the other.

items.question: What happens after I contact LawProactive?
items.answer: We ask a few questions about what happened and who was lost, then connect you with an independent wrongful death attorney who serves Siskiyou County. Our service costs nothing, and the attorney works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You are under no obligation to hire anyone after the conversation.
